milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the melon cluster (centered at ~3,0,3) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. Target is the center of the 4-melon cross pattern. max_distance=16 allows detection from reasonable range, facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the melons.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must approach the glass-walled structure (spanning x=8-14, z=2-8) and face toward it. Target is the center of the glass building at (11, 2, 5). max_distance=8 requires the player to be reasonably close to the structure, facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a jukebox with any tool drops the jukebox block as an item into the player's inventory. The jukebox is at (11,1,5) inside the glass structure. A diamond pickaxe is provided. After mining, the jukebox item appears in inventory, which is the definitive proof of task completion.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The beacon is placed at (17, 3, 5) on iron blocks behind the glass structure. The player must navigate through/around the glass building to get close to the beacon and face it. max_distance=8 requires proximity (beacon is elevated at y+3 so horizontal distance matters), facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.
